changes.text: 还要说，作者认为，一次认错未必改变了廉颇的脾气。后来赵孝成王去世，悼襄王即位，派乐乘去替代廉颇，廉颇怒而攻乐乘，乐乘跑掉，廉颇便投奔魏国大梁。另据记载，他自长平免归失势时门客散尽，复用为将时门客又回来，门客还说「天下以市道交」，有势就来、无势就走本是常理。把这些放在一起，不是要给谁下道德评语，只是想提示：相如门前那次负荆谢罪见于本篇《史记》记载，但一种解释是，它未必把一个人从此改写。

The author's reading is that one apology did not necessarily remake Lian Po's temper. When King Xiaocheng of Zhao died, his successor King Daoxiang sent Le Cheng to replace Lian Po; Lian Po, enraged, attacked Le Cheng, who fled, and Lian Po then went over to Daliang in Wei. According to another passage, when he was dismissed after Changping and lost power, his retainers had all left, and when he was made a general again they came back; one of them told him that the world conducts its friendships on market terms (in translation): people come when you have power and leave when you do not. None of this is a moral verdict on anyone. It is only meant to note that the apology at Lin Xiangru's gate is recorded in this chapter of the Shiji, though on one reading it need not have rewritten the man from that day on.
本文所据为《史记·廉颇蔺相如列传》单一篇章；对话与负荆细节无法以其他材料互证；凡原文未写的人物心理与动机，均以“一种解释是”“作者认为”标明为解释；缪贤旧事与廉颇请罪的并置仅是作者提示，不代表存在影响关系。

This piece rests on the single chapter of Sima Qian's biography of Lian Po and Lin Xiangru. The speeches and the details of the thorn-apology cannot be cross-checked against other sources. Where the original text says nothing about a figure's psychology or motive, the piece marks its claims as one reading or as the author's view. The juxtaposition of Miao Xian's old affair and Lian Po's apology is the author's observation only and implies no influence between them.

dispositions.rationale: 证据只记载了此后的事件：廉颇攻乐乘、奔魏，以及门客“市道交”之语。这些记载并没有说明负荆请罪是否改变了他的性情。原结尾“它也没有把一个人从此改写”是断言，已改为明确标注的作者解释：中文改作“但一种解释是，它未必把一个人从此改写”，英文同步改为“though on one reading it need not have rewritten the man from that day on”。“只是说明”相应改为“只是想提示”，以免口气过于确定。其余句子未动。

evidence.quote: 廉頗怒，攻樂乘，樂乘走。廉頗遂奔魏之大梁。

dispositions.rationale: 正文中实际使用的标注是“作者认为”“作者解释”“作者提示”“作者提出”，没有“作者推断”。因此把说明中的“作者推断”改为“作者认为”，与 limits.0 和正文的标注保持一致。英文同步把“the author's inference”改为“the author's view”。
